summary: Material choice for NFC business cards changes more than the visual finish. It affects brand perception, production practicality and how the card fits the intended user group.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
PVC - Team-wide rollouts and standard business-card programs - Scalable, familiar and production-friendly

faq.question: Is metal the best option for all premium NFC card projects?
faq.answer: No. Metal fits some premium programs well, but wood or even carefully finished PVC can be better if the brand story or rollout model points elsewhere.

faq.question: Should teams decide on material before workflow?
faq.answer: No. The tap behavior, target phones and redirect logic should be confirmed first so the material decision supports the actual use case.
